text: {"lessons":["Selling winners in small chunks can feel satisfying, but I should judge each position by its future prospects and my overall portfolio plan, not just gains since my purchase.","I should avoid letting reluctance to realize a loss keep me holding a stock; set clear, forward-looking reasons for holding or selling instead.","Frequent trading and buying after a sharp rise can increase concentration and timing risk, so I should consider diversification and disciplined position sizes."]}
